meta.title: Developer dashboard
meta.description: Three Marks API keys, request statistics, error log and webhooks.

header.title: API and webhooks
header.lead: Keys, quota usage, request errors and webhook deliveries — everything about your integrations in one place.

warning.key: Copy the key and store it in a secret manager or an environment variable. Once this window closes you cannot see it again — only issue a new one.
warning.webhook: Every delivery is signed with this secret. Save it now: it will not be shown again after this window closes.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Send the key in the X-API-Key header. Up to {max} active keys per account.
keys.limit: You have reached {max} active keys — revoke one you no longer need to issue a new one.
keys.emptyHint: Create your first key and start calling /v1.
keys.revokeText: Key “{name}” stops working immediately and every request with it gets a 401. This cannot be undone.

createKey.title: New API key
createKey.description: Name the key after the project so you always know where it is used.
createKey.secretDescription: Copy it now — the dashboard keeps only its prefix.
createKey.name: Name

errors.name: Name must be 1 to {max} characters
errors.server: The server did not create the key. Try again.

usage.title: Requests and errors
usage.description: How many requests each key sends, where it stumbles and how much of today’s quota is left.
usage.noKeysHint: Statistics appear once you have at least one key.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: The server POSTs to your URL when a player in the filter earns a mark, finishes a session, or a clan roster changes.
webhooks.limit: {count} of {max} webhooks used on your tier.
webhooks.emptyHint: Add a URL and events will start coming in.
webhooks.deleteText: Deliveries to {url} stop, and the delivery log goes with the webhook.
webhooks.failures: {count, plural, one {# failure in a row} other {# failures in a row}}

create.title: New webhook
create.description: https only. Follow players, clans or both.

edit.title: Edit webhook
edit.description: Editing does not change the signing secret.

secret.title: Webhook created
secret.description: Verify every delivery’s signature with this secret.

webhookForm.urlHint: It must answer 2xx within a few seconds.
webhookForm.idsHint: Separated by commas or spaces, up to {max} ids.
webhookForm.clanIdsHint: A clan also brings its members’ events.

errors.ids: Only positive numbers separated by commas or spaces
errors.filterEmpty: Add at least one player or clan
errors.filterTooMany: No more than {max} ids in a list
errors.server: The server did not save the webhook. Try again.
